name: chhath_bgm
caption: Instrumental Indian devotional background score for a festival guide video, warm hopeful uplifting mood with gentle longing, sunrise at a river ghat. Soft bansuri flute melody, sitar, harmonium, tanpura drone, light tabla and manjira, temple bells. Joyful, festive, devotional, warm, no vocals, no singing, no chant, steady gentle rhythm.
